Fleet Logistics Mesh — Functional Spec

Three-tier mesh: a UI coordinator, a department orchestrator, and a domain agent.

Agent: logistics-coordinator

role: ui-coordinator

tier: fast-path

objective: Route inbound transport requests to the right department orchestrator.

delegates_to: fleet-orchestrator

egress: api.carrier-eu.example, tracking.carrier-eu.example

States

  • T01 intake — request received
  • T02 classify — determine department

Entry Points

  • EP-INT ingress — transport request arrives → T01

Tools

  • classify_request — pick the target department
  • delegate_to_orchestrator — hand off downstream (mutating)

Agent: fleet-orchestrator

role: domain-agent

tier: standard

objective: Orchestrate fleet assignment within the logistics department.

delegates_to: customs-agent

hitl_threshold_eur: 25000

States

  • T01 receive — handoff payload received
  • T05 assign — vehicle assigned (invariant: driver hours within legal limit)
  • T07 confirm [HOLD] — awaiting ops confirmation

Entry Points

  • EP-CAP capture — orchestrator receives handoff → T01

Tools

  • assign_vehicle — choose a compliant vehicle (mutating)
  • check_driver_hours — verify legal driving hours

Entities

  • vehicle(id, plate, capacity_kg, status)
  • driver(id, name, hours_this_week)

Invariants

  • Driver weekly hours must not exceed the legal maximum.
  • Assignments over €25,000 require human approval.

Agent: customs-agent

role: sub-agent

tier: deep

objective: Validate cross-border customs documentation for assigned loads.

States

  • T01 validate — documents received
  • T04 clear — customs cleared

Entry Points

  • EP-HS handoff — receive from orchestrator → T01

Tools

  • validate_documents — check HS codes and manifests
